description: MiG-21FL C606 (delivered 27 June 1967, last flight 20 Aug 1990, 2300 hrs, then instructional at Barrackpore; allotted to Port Blair 3 Feb 2015) pole-mounted before the HQ ANC building near Port Blair airfield, erected c.April 2023, with detailed placard. Source warbirds.in (Mar 2024, Akshay Saseendran photo), bharat-rakshak.
museum_name: HQ Andaman and Nicobar Command Port Blair
